description: Two storey rear extension; external alterations
decision_conditions: <div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;">The proposed two-storey rear extension, by reason of its scale, bulk and design, would form an inappropriate and unduly obtrusive addition that is incongruous with the original dwelling. The development would result in a cumulative overdevelopment of the site, failing to respect the character, proportions and appearance of the host property and the visual amenities of the surrounding area. As such, the proposal would be contrary to the high-quality design objectives of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021–2041), and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</div>

<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The
proposed two storey rear extension, by reason of its scale, depth and proximity
to the shared boundary, would breach the 45-degree guideline when assessed from
the nearest habitable room window of No. 62A. As a result, the development
would give rise to an unacceptable loss of light and an increased sense of
overbearing enclosure and tunnelling effect to that neighbouring occupier, to the detriment of their
residential amenity. The proposal is therefore considered to result in a
harmful impact on neighbouring living conditions and is contrary to the
high-quality design objectives of the National Planning Policy Framework
(2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local
Plan (2021–2041), and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
